add.title: Write down a meal
add.body: A meal at a restaurant has no recipe and needs nobody to invent one. A name and a calorie count are enough.
add.name: Meal

NOTHING_LOGGED.finding: Nothing is written down this week.
NOTHING_LOGGED.action: Add a meal above, even a rough one: it is more use than an empty week.

PARTIAL_WEEK.action: The averages cover those days, not the whole week.

ENERGY_VS_TARGET.finding: {average} kcal on average per day written down, against a target of {target}.
ENERGY_VS_TARGET.action: A gap of {gap} kcal ({gapPercent}%). If it holds for weeks, it is the target that gets adjusted.

PROTEIN_BELOW_TARGET.finding: Protein: {average} g on average, against {target} g.
PROTEIN_BELOW_TARGET.action: A protein source at breakfast usually covers most of the missing {gap} g.

CONTAINS_ESTIMATES.finding: Some of this week's ingredients are estimated.
CONTAINS_ESTIMATES.action: The totals are orders of magnitude. Naming an ingredient more precisely is often enough for it to be recognised.

import.intro: Paste a recipe link. We read the page, photo included, you fix what is missing.
import.urlHint: Marmiton, Betty Bossi, Swissmilk, Fooby, Cookidoo and most cooking sites.

not_a_url.title: That is not a link
not_a_url.body: A link starts with http:// or https://.

unreachable.body: The site did not answer, or it turns automated visitors away. You can enter the recipe by hand.

unreadable.title: Nothing to import on that page
unreadable.body: It does not publish its recipe in a machine-readable format. Nothing is lost: enter it by hand.

unsupported_format.title: That file is not an image
unsupported_format.body: JPEG, PNG or WebP. The file name is not enough: the content is what gets read.

file_too_large.title: Image too heavy
file_too_large.body: 2 MB per image at most. A cropped phone photo fits easily.

ai_unavailable.title: Not wired up yet
ai_unavailable.body: No reader is configured yet. A link or typing it in both work today.

upgrade_required.title: This reading is part of a paid plan
upgrade_required.body: Importing from a link stays free and unlimited.

no_file.title: No photo chosen
no_file.body: Pick at least one image of the recipe.

ai_budget_exhausted.title: This month's reading budget is spent
ai_budget_exhausted.body: Image readings are billed one by one, and this month's are used up. The counter restarts on the 1st. Importing from a link stays free and unlimited.

provider.title: The reading failed
provider.body: The reading service did not answer properly. Your photos are still there: try again, or type the recipe in.

sources.label: Where the recipe comes from
sources.urlHint: Marmiton, Betty Bossi, Swissmilk, Fooby, Cookidoo and most cooking sites.
sources.photoHint: A page of a book, a recipe card, something written by hand. Two photos if the recipe runs over two pages.
sources.screenshotHint: A capture from another app, a story or a message. Frame the whole recipe, not only the ingredients.
sources.filesHint: JPEG, PNG or WebP, 2 MB per image at most.

PLAN.title: This reading is part of the {tier} plan
PLAN.body: Reading a photo or a capture takes a model, and every reading is billed. It is the one feature the launch period does not open — importing from a link stays free and unlimited.

SOON.title: Not wired up yet
SOON.body: Your plan is fine, we are the ones who are not ready: no reader is configured yet. Nothing is lost — a link or typing it in both work today.

crop.title: Keep only the recipe
crop.body: Drag the frame to cut away the facing page, your hand, the table. Touch nothing and the whole image is sent.

export.title: Export all my data
export.body: Recipes and photos, plan, shopping, journal, profile, weigh-ins, preferences — in one archive. It is built in the background and a link arrives by email; it works once, for 24 hours, and then the archive is erased from our disks.
export.asked: On its way. The link arrives at {email}.

delete.title: Delete my account
delete.body: Everything that is yours is deleted, at once and with nobody in the loop. What belongs to other members of a household stays theirs.

recommend.title: Recommend Fuelr
recommend.hint: A link to share and a message ready to send. Nothing more — no plan is paid for, so there is nothing to promise.

recommend.count: {count, plural, =0 {Nobody has come by this link yet.} one {One person came by this link.} other {# people came by this link.}}
recommend.honest: We count, we do not say who. The day a plan becomes paid, this link will let us say thank you — not before.

reminder.title: A weekly reminder
reminder.hint: The only email Fuelr sends without having to. Off until you ask for it.
reminder.switch: Remind me to plan my week
reminder.transactional: What it says is decided when it is sent: “your week is empty” or “your list is ready”. Every reminder carries a one-click link to stop it. Verification and password emails cannot be turned off — they are not preferences.

unsubscribe.title: Reminder stopped
unsubscribe.done: Done: you will not receive the weekly reminder any more. It can be turned back on from your account, should you want it one day.
unsubscribe.expired: This link no longer works. The reminder is set from your account.
unsubscribe.noToken: This link is incomplete. Open the one in the email.
